text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after
team training had stopped going smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An incident occurred!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah—!
Trai~neeer~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I went and started an impromptu race with Team <First>!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, sorry for acting on my own!
You see, the thing is--

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Huh... Whose drink is this...?
There's no name on it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If it's out in the sun, it'll get lukewarm...
Let's move it to the shade—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! I-It all spilled...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, Little Cocon—the owner of the drink—
arrived at the worst possible time—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Well, we are a team that gets plenty of hate, so maybe this kinda stuff is par for the course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing the commotion, the team members began gathering one after another—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No! She didn't do it on purpose!
Rice isn't that kind of girl!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no way you just "accidentally"
knock over an entire drink! That's impossible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So things got heated, and when the members
of Team First stepped in to break it up—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then we're having an impromptu race right here!
Let's settle this with a nice, clean match!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
“Just an ordinary match would be boring, though!
How 'bout the loser gets banned from using the track for life?!”

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
That's an interesting offer. I'm in.
You guys look weak, so I'll give you a handicap.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
If you can take even a single race,
I'll let you have the win.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
M-Mmmmmmgh~! You can only talk like that
while you still have the chance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so it seemed...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurried over to the grounds,
only to find the race had already started—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Urara! Fight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The entire team leaned over the spectator railing,
cheering their hearts out for Haru Urara mid-race.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry for jumping in on our own...
But we just couldn't let this slide...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
However, that team over there
is suuuper strong, and Urara is...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: H-Hyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The dirt race taking place on the track was only halfway through, but the outcome was already clear—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Soooo strooong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Crossing the finish line with a massive gap behind the leader!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Besides, their abilities go without saying, but everyone is also so cool—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Warm-up complete.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo, hoo, hoo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, even when a teammate won, they only gave a brief glance
before quietly continuing with their own warm-ups."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was in stark contrast to our team,
who were eagerly cheering away.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, it kinda feels like everyone's fighting
individually... like true pros, you know?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I must brace myself as well...! Come to think of it,
how are our race records looking right now?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Weeell...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-We lost every match...!? Which means
all that's left is my Medium distance, and Rice-san's Long distance!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Sowwy... Maybe because I wasn't
focused on training, I was off my game, YES..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I can't just stand around! I need to start warming up right now, too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, the medium-distance race held after that—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Seiyaaa! For the team!
I won't lose! There's no way I'll lose!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I can do it! I will do it! Pure guts~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why...!
Why is the gap opening up～～?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I really wanted to win...
At this rate, the grounds will be...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't worry! We still have the Long distance race!
As long as Rice wins, everything will be fine, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Rice! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Please, Rice-san!
You have to win...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You'll be just fine, Rice-chan!
You're totaaaally gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah...
Rice... has to make sure she wins...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, when Rice Shower left,
her face was stark white."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curious, I chased after her—
only to find her standing frozen in place.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's all Rice's fault to begin with...
I just have to win...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Rice, hang in there...
O-oh...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...*sniffle*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though I rushed over, I was one step too late; pale as a ghost, Rice Shower ran off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My fears came true.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa! I-I can't lose...!
The team will be in trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Ready, and...! Do your best, Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh!? What!?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Ha, chickening out, are we?
Not really used to running for everyone else's sake,
right?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Maybe you should quit the team...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower was defeated,
trailing behind by five lengths.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Rice... Rice...!
It's all Rice's fault the grounds are...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No, we couldn't win eitheeeer.
Nobody could win, after all...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
However... being forbidden from using the grounds
really puts us in a bind, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The team members are shaken, but... honestly,
there's no way such an unreasonable bet could ever stand.
choice_data_list: Let's discuss the wager with Agent Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's sure to be deemed invalid," I said,
and the team members visibly relaxed with relief.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all!
Then we're totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Even so, the fact that not a single one of them won does bother me a little."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It starts right now, Fukukitaru! Let's all
join forces and get to training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the team members regained
their usual friendly, harmonious atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After speaking with Acting Director Kashimoto, the ban on using the track was successfully lifted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... from that day on, whenever Rice Shower came to team practice,
her expression seemed somewhat gloomy.
